subject: Waterway information - North Coast
text:
Waterway information - North Coast
The Canadian Coast Guard is requesting assistance to observe, record and report any marine mammal sightings in
Grenville Channel and vicinity of Hartley Bay.
Send reports to the CCG Regional Operations Centre 1-800-889-8852 or by email  ROC1COR1@dfo-mpo.gc.ca.
                                                    Cancels NW-P-1550-22
